query: 先查书里 HafSOx 用 EUV 干涉光刻报道过的最细半间距是多少,再顺着查 MPPM 随机极限分析里,无机胶和 CA 胶比是哪个随机项占主导、趋势怎么反过来。
source_id: Materials and Processes for Next Generation Lithography (Alex Robinson and Richard Lawson (Eds.))
gold_standard: 第一跳:2012 年 Ekinci 等报道 HafSOx 用 EUV 干涉光刻做出 11 nm 半间距线条/空间图形。第二跳:在 MPPM 与实测 LWR 对比中,CA 胶是材料项(material term)最大且与光子项相当,而转向无机胶后趋势反转,变成光子项(photon component)占主导。
success_criteria: 两跳齐全:HafSOx EUV-IL 11 nm 半间距;无机胶为光子项占主导(CA 胶为材料项最大)。
evidence: --[p377]-- In 2012, Ekinci et al. reported 11-nm half-pitch line-space HafSOx patterns by using EUV interference lithography. --[p195]-- For all the CA resists, we find the material term to be the largest but on par with the photon term. --[p195]-- Turning to the inorganic resist, we see the trend reverse with the photon component being dominant.

query: 书里有个研究把一支总 LER 2.9 nm 的胶分解成几个模糊来源,分别是多少 nm?哪个贡献最大?为什么作者说酸扩散相关的 blur 不只受 PAG 统计的影响?结合碱淬灭剂的作用机制解释一下。
source_id: Materials and Processes for Next Generation Lithography (Alex Robinson and Richard Lawson (Eds.))
gold_standard: 对总 LER 2.9 nm 的胶,计算得到:电子 blur 贡献 1.9 nm、酸扩散 0.9 nm、PAG 统计 0.6 nm、quencher(淬灭剂)统计 1.8 nm;单相最大贡献是电子 blur(1.9 nm)。作者指出 quencher 统计项的 blur 值很大,说明酸扩散及其相关 blur 不仅受 PAG 随机性影响,还受其他因素( specifically quencher)影响。机制上:碱淬灭剂通过中和光酸使其失去去保护能力而起作用,常规负载为 PAG 的 5~30%,其局部分布的计数涨落因此直接进入酸Blur的统计。
success_criteria: 四个数值(1.9/0.9/0.6/1.8 nm)齐全且指出最大项为电子 blur(1.9 nm);能结合"淬灭剂中和光酸、负载 5–30% PAG"的机制解释 quencher 统计的影响。
evidence: --[p172]-- For a resist with total LER of 2.9 nm, these researchers calculated that the electron blur contributes 1.9 nm, acid diffusion 0.9 nm, PAG statistics 0.6 nm, and quencher statistics 1.8 nm. The large blur value found for this latter phenomenon indicates that the acid diffusion (and the acid diffusion–related blur) is affected not only by the stochasticity of the PAG but also by other contributions, specifically the quencher. --[p59]-- Base quenchers work by neutralizing the photoacid to eliminate its ability to carry out deprotection and other reactions. They are now commonly loaded into the resist at 5–30% of the PAG loading; too high and the resist may fail to pattern.

query: 书里提到有个研究把酸扩散长度从 90 nm 一直调到 37 nm,这个扩散长度影响的是图形粗糙度的哪个指标?按第 1 章的说法,控制酸扩散常用哪三种方法?
source_id: Materials and Processes for Next Generation Lithography (Alex Robinson and Richard Lawson (Eds.))
gold_standard: 该研究把扩散长度从 90 nm 调到 37 nm,考察的是扩散长度与 LER 的相关长度(correlation length ξ,即 LER 的低频分量)之间的关系;相关长度越低越好,因为它对器件性能有不利影响(如短沟道 FET 制造)。控制酸扩散的三种常用方法:提高光刻胶的 Tg、增大光酸阴离子尺寸、添加碱淬灭剂(base quencher)。
success_criteria: 答出扩散长度调变 90→37 nm 影响的是 LER 相关长度(低频分量),并完整列出三种控制方法:Tg、阴离子尺寸、碱淬灭剂。
evidence: --[p169]-- Another relevant effect of acid diffusion is its relationship with the correlation length ξ of the LER, that is, its low frequency component, a parameter which has a detrimental effect on device performance. The relationship between these two quantities is described by a study where the diffusion length was tuned from 90 to 37 nm as shown in Fig. 20. --[p57]-- Three methods are commonly used to control acid diffusion: increasing the Tg of the resist, increasing the anion size of the photoacid, and addition of base quencher.
